title: Test-free AITIS model identifies sarcopenia in stage IV-V chronic kidney disease
summary: A previously developed AI model, AITIS, applied to age, sex, height, weight and 20 functional measures in 236 patients with stage IV-V non-dialysis CKD (62 with sarcopenia, 26.3%) identified sarcopenia against AWGS 2019 criteria with AUC 0.792 (0.729-0.856), sensitivity 0.597, specificity 0.816 and accuracy 0.758. The study is cross-sectional with moderate sensitivity, a single cohort and model internals are not described in the abstract.
ai_technology: Previously developed AITIS (Artificial Intelligence to Identify Sarcopenia) model applied without measurement testing

evidence.tested: Application of a pretrained model to a new CKD population, assessed against AWGS 2019 criteria.
evidence.unknown: Model internals; prospective performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A pretrained AI model predicted sarcopenia from demographic and functional items without grip, performance or muscle-mass tests.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
